title: Agreement of the graph-only and state occurrence spaces
statement: Let $s$ be a state of the contraction process, consisting of a multigraph $G$ together with a distinguished cut of $G$. Then the graph-only occurrence space built from $G$ coincides, as a finite set of edge occurrences $(e, k) \in \mathrm{Sym}_2\,\alpha \times \bbn$, with the state's sample space of edge occurrences; that is, both are the set of edge occurrences of the state's underlying multigraph.
hypotheses_covered: s is a state of the contraction process (a multigraph with a distinguished cut)
replaced:
For every state $s$, the graph-only occurrence space of $s.G$ equals the occurrence space
of $s$.
